repairedThisWave.defect: Restore accepted non-project job targets, dangling record links, null/array payloads and invalid retry counts.

repairedThisWave.defect: Old provider verification could mark newly saved credentials ready; named verification returned legacy provider metadata.
repairedThisWave.repair: Compare-and-swap exact encrypted configuration and independent verification identity; return the selected provider status.

repairedThisWave.defect: Project deletion and snapshot clear removed audit parent rows but retained repo_tree/repo_file rows keyed to the audit ID, leaving orphan artifacts and invalid future backups.
repairedThisWave.repair: Delete only the selected project audit children before audit parents in the guarded transaction; a unique snapshot-clear identity prevents stale cleanup from following a failed update.

repairedThisWave.issue: Executive screen exposed seven heuristic categories rather than the original fourteen evidence-qualified dimensions.
